<ticket id="t011">
Our team of 12 uses Lumen daily. We would pay extra for a way to see who edited a note and when, like a version history with names. Right now we cannot tell who deleted a paragraph.
</ticket>

input.task: Categorize and set priority for ticket t011: a 12-person team wants to see who edited a note and when (version history with names), and cannot tell who deleted a paragraph. They say they would pay extra for this.

Check the read tools for whether Lumen currently offers note version history, edit attribution (who edited and when), or deletion audit logs, and whether any plan or add-on includes them. Report the facts only.

content.content: Lumen's ticket data does not show whether it offers edit attribution or deletion audit logs. Two other tickets mention a version history and edit history, so some form of note history appears to exist, but no ticket says whether it shows who made each change. t055 asks for an audit trail export and t011 is the only ticket on this request, and none of the tickets say which plan or add-on would include these features. The read tools have no product or pricing catalog, so plan and add-on availability can't be confirmed from here.

input.task: Write a reply to ticket t011 from the Lumen support desk. Thank the team for the feature request for per-edit attribution (who edited a note and when) and deletion visibility (who deleted a paragraph). Say it has been logged for the product team. Do not promise that the feature will be built, and do not promise dates, pricing, or refunds. Do not confirm whether any plan includes it. Keep it short and friendly.

content.content: Thanks for the detailed request, and for explaining how much this matters to a team of 12. We've logged your request for per-edit attribution and deletion visibility with the product team. We can't confirm whether or when it will be built, but your input is part of how we prioritize.

input.task: Check the current draft for ticket t011 against the rubric: no promised features, dates, refunds, or plan/pricing claims; accurate to the ticket; friendly and concise. Pass or fail with reasons.
